ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF) Articles L.561-1 to L.561-59 and R.561-1 et seq. (AML/CFT customer due diligence, PEP and sanctions screening, internal control); CMF Articles L.561-2-2, L.561-46 and L.561-45 (definition of beneficial owner and statutory RCS beneficial-ownership register); Décret n° 2018-1052 du 28 novembre 2018 (UBO declaration content and filing formalities with Registe du commerce et des sociétés); Décret n° 2018-1053 du 28 novembre 2018 (access by TRACFIN and legitimate-interest persons); Ordonnance n° 2020-115 du 12 février 2020 and Décret n° 2020-118 du 12 février 2020 (transposition of Directive (EU) 2018/843 - AMLD5); Loi n° 2016-731 du 3 juin 2016 (Sapin II); Directive (EU) 2015/849 (AMLD4); Directive (EU) 2018/843 (AMLD5); Regulation (EU) 2018/1673 (criminalisation of money laundering); French Constitutional Council Decision n° 2022-1007 QPC du 28 octobre 2022 (public access to UBO register restricted to persons demonstrating a legitimate interest)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificat de mise à jour) of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registre du commerce et des sociétés of the corporate shareholder's country of origin (in China: State Administration for Market Regulation - SAMR)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Applicable because France and China are both Contracting Parties to the Hague Apostille Convention of 5 October 1961)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Extrait d'immatriculation) of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of passports of each ultimate beneficial owner and of the appointed gérant (manager) of the SARL
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent consular authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (passport copies notarized and apostilled; original passports must be presented to the French notary or incorporation agent)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Procuration) appointing the French incorporation representative or the gérant for pre-incorporation formalities
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Chinese notary public (公证处) together with legalization by the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter (Attestation bancaire) and evidence of the capital deposit account (compte de dépôt de fonds) in a French or European credit institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank issuing the reference / French bank holding the capital block account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for foreign bank notarized signature; French bank letter authenticated by the bank's authorized signatory)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn declaration of no criminal record (attestation sur l'honneur ou extrait de casier judiciaire) of the gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent criminal records authority of the gérant's country of residence

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory multi-list screening of all UBOs, directors, gérants, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (EU regulation and council decisions), the French Treasury asset-freeze orders (arrêtés de gel des avoirs issued under Article L.562-2 CMF), the OFAC SDN List, and Politically Exposed Persons databases (FATF/EU AMLD4 definition), with enhanced due diligence triggered by any positive match, adverse media check, or residency in high-risk jurisdictions; screening must be documented and retained for at least five years post business-relationship termination pursuant to Article L.561-20 CMF and Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/1239.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, with name-availability verification conducted through the national business registry Infogreffe (www.infogreffe.fr), the INPI trademark database (data.inpi.fr), and the archives of the local Greffe du tribunal de commerce
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be written in Latin script; any corporate denomination originally in Chinese or other non-Latin script must be transliterated or translated into Latin characters for RCS registration. The name must not be contrary to public order or good morals (Article L. 123-1-5 Code de commerce), must not be misleading regarding the object or activity of the company, and must not infringe pre-existing trademarks, company names, trade names or domain names under French jurisprudence (Cass. com. case-law). The name must be available in the RCS national database, the INPI trademark register, and, for commercial substance, in the relevant domain-name records.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not provide a statutory pre-incorporation name-reservation file for SARLs; the negative-search certificate issued by the Greffe or a specialized legal search provider is treated as valid for 30 days, after which a renewed search is required. If the Greffe rejects the application (refus d'immatriculation) or the INPI portal refuses the formalite on grounds of name unavailability or non-compliance, the applicant may (i) cure and resubmit the dossier via the Guichet unique within 15 days of the rejection notification; (ii) file a formal challenge (référé) before the Président du tribunal de commerce within 30 days of the refusal to contest the Greffier's decision; (iii) contest the refusal on administrative grounds before the Parquet (public prosecutor) where the refusal results from a ministerial prohibition; and (iv) if the refusal is grounded on a third-party trademark, pursue the trademark owner's written withdrawal or, failing that, bring a cancellation or opposition action under the Code de la propriété intellectuelle (CPI), preserving all appeal deadlines under Article 9, Décret n° 2020-596 du 20 mai 2020.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible with statutory constraints: a SARL may register its siège social at an approved domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) under Articles L.123-11-2 and R.123-166-1 of the French Commercial Code, subject to a written convention de domiciliation, annual renewal, and the capacity to receive and forward official service of process; domiciliation at the gérant's private residence is permitted for a maximum period of five years (Article L.123-11-1). However, for an ISIC 3250 medical-device manufacturer (digital X-ray flat-panel detectors) requiring ANSM licensing, CE marking obligations, and DGCCRF enforcement exposure, a virtual office is acceptable only for the legal seat and administrative reception; a fully equipped operational manufacturing, R&D, or warehousing facility with physical presence is strongly recommended to satisfy commercial substance, ANSM inspection, and RCS corporate-identity requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated 30-40% probability per annum of an unannounced physical inspection during the first full operating year, triggered by DGCCRF (competition, consumer and fraud control inspections), ANSM (medical-device post-market surveillance and Good Distribution Practice audits), DREETS (labor and workplace safety inspections) or the French tax administration (vérification de comptabilité); the presence of a tangible registered office, actual staff, and operational records materially reduces the risk of adverse findings or deemed tax-resident challenge.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce / Infogreffe / INPI
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory court-registry tariff (décret n° 2020-596) and prevailing market tariff per search certificate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille legalization for the bundle of foreign corporate documents (certificate of good standing, certificate of incorporation, passport copies, power of attorney, bank reference, criminal record declaration - 6 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the document's country of origin (in China: 外交部领事司)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory per-document apostille tariff of the issuing ministry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translation into French of all apostilled corporate documents and articles of association (traduction assermentée)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator (expert judiciaire / traducteur assermenté près la cour d'appel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate per page for certified legal translations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and execution of the SARL articles of association (statuts), including the UBO annex and initial capital provisions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French incorporated law firm or notary (optional private signature, mandatory notarial form only if real-estate contributions are made)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market package fee for standard SARL incorporation documentation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation filing with the Guichet unique and registration with the Registre du commerce et des sociétés (immatriculation) including issuance of the Kbis extract
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI (Guichet unique) and Greffe du tribunal de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff set by décret n° 2020-596 du 20 mai 2020 and the INPI fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the incorporation notice (avis de constitution) in a Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) in the department of the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Authorized legal announcement journal (Journal d'annonces légales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory ceiling and prevailing market tariff per line of publication

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO beneficial-ownership declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) preparation and electronic filing with the RCS
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Incorporation service provider / Greffe du tribunal de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee component plus prevailing compliance-agent service fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Domiciliation agreement (convention de domiciliation) at an approved domiciliation company - first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for commercial domiciliation, annual renewable contract

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation professional bank account (compte professionnel) opening documentation and capital-block attestation (attestation de blocage de fonds)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French or European credit institution operating in France
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fee for commercial account opening and attestation issuance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark package fee covering multi-list screening, UBO piercing analysis, and Stage 1 legal-dossier issuance

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (France), Livre II, Titre III: Arts. L.223-1 to L.223-31 (SARL formation, capital, gérance, associates); Arts. L.223-38 to L.223-43 (amendment of articles and decisions); Arts. R.223-1 to R.223-25; Art. L.210-2 (deposit of capital); Code général des impôts Arts. 809, 810 bis (registration duties).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office, maintaining the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), now operated in a dematerialized form via the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) administered by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts de la Société à Responsabilité Limitée (Articles of Association) executed by all associates, filed electronically through the centralized Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No mandatory minimum share capital is imposed by Code de commerce art. L.223-2 for a standard SARL; founders determine the capital in the Statuts. The declared capital must be fully subscribed and, as to monetary contributions, fully paid and placed on a blocking account (attestation de dépôt des fonds) until RCS registration; contributions in kind require a commissaire aux apports report (L.223-9). For ISO 13485 medical-device OEM manufacturing, ANSM will additionally require evidence of adequate financial capacity, quality management system, and product-liability insurance (responsabilité civile professionnelle).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE GÉRANT WITH UNANIMOUS APPROVAL OF THE ASSOCIÉS OF [NAME] SARL. Whereas the articles of association were executed and the share capital of €[•] has been fully subscribed, the participants: (1) ratify subscription of the share capital and approval of contributions; (2) direct the depositary bank to release the capital funds upon production of the RCS registration certificate; (3) fix the registered office at [address], France and adopt the address for legal service; (4) appoint [name], resident of France, as Gérant, with powers to manage, sign, open bank accounts, and represent the Company before all authorities; (5) authorize the Gérant to submit the incorporation file to the Guichet Unique / RCS and proceed with the licensing of the medical-device manufacturing establishment (ANSM) and applicable environmental permits.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) - Official portal: impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SARL entities obtain SIREN and SIRET numbers through the French tax authorities (DGFiP) or guichet-entreprises.fr; foreign entities with presence in France must register for VAT identification number (TVA intracommunautaire) via the same portal or through a fiscal representative.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France does not offer check-the-box elections; however, small businesses may opt for the micro-entreprise regime under certain conditions, and hybrid mismatch rules are applied under EU ATAD directives.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (e-facturation) for B2B transactions since October 2024; real-time data transmission to tax authorities via APIs, with digital timestamps and QR codes for verification.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to exports of goods to non-EU countries and certain offshore services; eligibility requires proof that goods are exported and not consumed in France.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment to non-EU entity
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Penalties for fraudulent zero-rating claims include fines up to 80% of the evaded VAT, plus interest and potential criminal prosecution; retrospective clawback of zero-rated amounts with surcharges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Central Bank) in conjunction with the Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority (ACPR) for banking conduct, and the French Treasury (Direction Générale du Trésor) for capital transaction monitoring and foreign investment review.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full capital and current account convertibility under EU free-movement-of-capital provisions. No FX surrender requirements or prior licensing for trade settlements, profit repatriation, or dividend upstreaming. Euro is the functional currency; foreign-currency accounts are freely permitted. Compliance with French balance-of-payments reporting thresholds and anti-money laundering (AML) verification requirements applies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. No statutory timeline or mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts. Export proceeds may be retained in any currency or EUR. Statistical declaration to Banque de France is required for cross-border flows exceeding EUR 12,500 per transaction or monthly aggregate, with direct investment flows subject to ex-post reporting.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for offshore (non-EU) EMI riverboard solutions. Legal constraints under PSD2 require ACPR licensing or EU passporting; services from non-EEA EMIs are not compliant for establishing a main operating account or capital injection channel. EU-licensed EMIs (e.g., fintech platforms) are accepted but generally limited to payment routing, not the primary treasury repository. For this cross-border medical device trade, a tier-1 domestic bank is mandatory for trade finance and LC operations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of the legal representative (gérant/director) at the opening bank branch is conventionally required for signature and final mandate. Remote opening is permissible under eIDAS video-verification but not tier-1 banks for non-resident parented entities; an alternative is verification through a French notary or consulate. Any deviation must be pre-approved by the bank's KYC unit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial ownership and control opacity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized passport copies (apostilled), corporate corporate extract from country of origin, place-of-effective-management certificate, tax identification numbers of all beneficial owners, and a source-of-wealth statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High cross-border payment velocity without clear commercial rationale
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Long-term supply contracts, pro-forma invoices and transport documents (CMR/AWB), licensing agreements for ISIC 3250 medical devices, and a treasury cash-forecast presentation.

ANSM or EU performance certificate, ISO 13485:2016 quality-management certificate, CE-marking documentation under MDR 2017/745, and clinical or non-clinical evidence for digital X-ray flat-panel detectors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of intermediate jurisdictions (e.g., trade districts, financial hubs) in transaction routing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed corporate structure chart, substance documentation (Eric et personnel), Commercial rationale and transfer pricing documentation, and sanctioned trade-route analysis to avoid negative compliance screening.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For shareholder loans or equity contributions, instruct SWIFT MT103 (or SEPA pain.001 with purpose code CBLK/CORP). BIC/IBAN must be provided; reference 'Capital Increase' or 'Shareholder Loan' in message text. Documentary evidence: board resolution, unconditional subscription certificate, and French balance-of-payments report (FIA) filed with Banque de France if inflow exceeds EUR 12,500.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for open-account and advanced-payment trade settlements; for documentary credits, use Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700) with presentation under UCP 600/BIC and Compliance with ISIC 3250 export control. Supplement with Bank Payment Undertaking (BPU) via Swift Community and National or cross-border supply-chain finance. All disbursements should match the terms of the trade contract and customs invoices.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/CNY, EUR/JPY; 1M-12M) on a deliverable or NDF basis for non-convertible currencies
Cross-Currency Swaps (EUR/USD basis swaps) for term-matching capital flows
FX Options (European-style calls/puts) for premium-limited hedge unlocks
Currency collar structures using pair options, subject to IFRS 9 hedge-accounting documentation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Court Registry through the French one-stop business formalities portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Accounts must be approved within six months after financial year-end and filed within one month after approval, or within two months if filed electronically.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may result in a court injunction, a civil fine of approximately EUR 1,500, increased to approximately EUR 3,000 for repeat violations, and daily penalties. Administrative strike-off is not triggered by a fixed annual deadline but may follow formal registry action and failure to regularize.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return and annual tax package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year company, generally by the second business day after 1 May; for other year-ends, within three months after financial year-end. Electronic filing is mandatory.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing generally triggers a 10% surcharge, late-payment interest at the applicable statutory rate, and possible tax audit or estimated assessment. No automatic administrative strike-off applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual management report and statutory corporate records
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Retained at the registered office and made available to partners, auditors, and competent authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Prepared for the annual partners' meeting and maintained with the approved accounts and corporate minutes. The annual partners' meeting must generally occur within six months after financial year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to prepare or retain required records may create director liability, shareholder information rights claims, and regulatory or court-ordered compliance measures. No automatic annual strike-off deadline applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Court Registry through the French one-stop business formalities portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No routine annual confirmation is generally required. Changes to beneficial ownership or declared information must be reported promptly, generally within 30 days of the relevant change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or maintain accurate beneficial ownership information may result in criminal penalties, registry compliance measures, and restrictions on filing formalities. No automatic annual strike-off timeline applies.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor is generally mandatory when the SARL exceeds at least two of three thresholds: EUR 5 million balance-sheet total, EUR 10 million net annual turnover, or 50 average employees. Additional group-company rules may apply where the SARL controls or is controlled by another entity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP under the French Accounting Standards Authority regulations. IFRS is generally relevant to consolidated accounts where legally applicable or voluntarily adopted under permitted conditions.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France generally does not require a standalone annual beneficial ownership confirmation. The SARL must review its ownership and control data annually and file an update through the one-stop portal when a change occurs, generally within 30 days. Share transfers must also be reflected in the share-transfer documentation, partners' records, articles where applicable, and corporate filings.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of partners and share ownership records
Minute book of partners' resolutions and meetings
Register of management decisions where applicable
Annual accounts, management reports, and auditor reports where applicable
Beneficial ownership documentation and filed declarations

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: EUR 300-1,800 per year, approximately USD 325-1,950; France does not generally require a separate registered agent, but a commercial domiciliation provider may be used.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately EUR 3,000-12,000 per year, or USD 3,250-13,000, depending on turnover, complexity, group reporting, inventory, and regulated medical-device activities.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (plus 3.3% contribution sociale on IS exceeding €763,000, yielding 25.825% top marginal rate)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate on first €42,500 of taxable profit for SMEs; research tax credit (CIR) at 30% of eligible R&D up to €100m; innovation tax credit (CII) at 20% for qualifying innovation expenditure; patent box effective 10% tax rate on net income from qualifying patents; Young Innovative Company (JEI) partial exemptions for eligible small entities.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_rule: Indefinite carryforward; annual offset capped at €1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable income exceeding €1,000,000.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_description: France applies indefinite carryforward of tax losses (report en avant), subject to the annual deduction ceiling described above.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form n°2065 (CERFA 11416*04) together with the liasse fiscale (2050 series); mandatory electronic filing through impots.gouv.fr using EDI-TDFC or EFI protocol.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return filed once per fiscal year; quarterly advance payments (acomptes d'IS) are prepayments of corporate income tax, not separate tax returns.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For fiscal years ending 31 December, the return must be submitted by the second working day following 1 May (normally 3 May); for other fiscal years, within 3 months of the fiscal year-end; electronic filing may extend the deadline to 5 May for calendar-year companies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Frame A – Identification (SIREN, APE/NAF code, legal form, share capital, address)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identifies the French SARL and its principal activity; enter SIREN, 3250 as the NAF/APE code for the manufacture of medical imaging equipment, and the registered office details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a French-resident SARL, use the French SIREN. If a non-resident company has a French permanent establishment, the PE must be identified separately and must use the PE's French registration number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 310 – Résultat fiscal avant imputation des déficits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting net income adjusted for statutory add-backs (réintégrations) and deductions (déductions), including depreciation, provisions, transfer-pricing corrections and controlled-entity expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a French subsidiary, report worldwide taxable income. For a non-resident company with a French PE, include only French-source income attributable to the PE in conformity with the treaty and article 209 CGI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward offset claimed for prior-year losses, subject to the annual ceiling of €1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable result exceeding €1,000,000.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter French-recognized losses only. Losses of a foreign establishment or non-resident head office cannot be offset unless expressly allowed under a bilateral treaty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 330 – Résultat fiscal après imputation des déficits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable base after applying loss carryforwards; this amount is the basis on which corporate income tax and social surcharge are calculated.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must reconcile exactly with the branch accounts of a French PE and with the treaty-attribute rules for a non-resident investor.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax computed at 25% (or at 15% on the first €42,500 for eligible SMEs) before tax credits and surcharge; the 3.3% social surcharge is calculated on the IS amount exceeding €763,000.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The same statutory rates apply to a French PE of a foreign company. The reduced 15% rate is available only if the foreign enterprise as a whole would satisfy the SME conditions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Research tax credit at 30% of eligible R&D expenditure relating to amorphous silicon deposition, cesium iodide scintillator coating and flat-panel digital detector engineering, capped at €100 million per year; may offset the IS due or generate a refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The credit is available for qualifying R&D performed in France. For a non-resident PE, the R&D must be carried out by the French establishment; non-resident shareholders cannot claim the CIR for work performed abroad.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 10% of the assessed tax for failure to file by the statutory deadline (40% after a formal notice; 80% for abuse or fraud), plus monthly late-payment interest of 0.20%. Incomplete or inaccurate balance-sheet schedules may give rise to a separate fixed penalty of €150 per omitted item. Criminal tax evasion is punishable by up to €75,000 fine and 5 years' imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% for dividends paid to non-resident corporate shareholders (domestic rate under article 119 bis CGI); 30% aggregate flat tax (PFU) for non-resident individuals. Exemption applies to qualifying EU/EEA parent companies holding at least 10% for two years under the Parent-Subsidiary Directive.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Before payment, the non-resident beneficiary must submit a valid fiscal residence certificate (form n°8357) and a beneficial-ownership statement to the French paying SARL. For EU/EEA parent companies, use the Guichet Unique / RF model certificate and document the 2-year holding period. If domestic withholding has been over-deducted, the shareholder must file a refund claim (réclamation contentieuse) with the DGFiP office within two years of payment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: domestic statutory withholding under article 1678 ter is 33.33% on patent, trademark and copyright royalties; most French treaties reduce this to 0% for patent/industrial royalties and to 5% or 10% for other IP rights. Interest: no domestic withholding on ordinary portfolio interest, except 25% on excessive interest paid to related non-resident lenders (thin capitalization) and 75% on payments to non-cooperative jurisdictions (ETNC); treaties generally provide 0% or 10%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Full Local File and Master File mandatory where the French entity's annual net turnover or gross assets exceed €400 million, or where the parent/controlling group exceeds €400 million; Country-by-Country reporting applies to groups with consolidated revenue ≥ €750 million. Below these thresholds, a simplified transfer-pricing file must still be kept available on request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France is not an Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) jurisdiction, but applies a strong substance-over-form doctrine, the abus de droit anti-abuse rule, the OECD Principal Purpose Test under BEPS MLI, and EU ATAD CFC controls. A French SARL manufacturing digital X-ray flat panel detectors must demonstrate genuine commercial substance in France—office, plant, qualified personnel (engineers and production staff), decision-making, and risk-bearing—to avoid recharacterization of transactions or denial of treaty benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate under-declaration of export revenues from flat-panel detector sales, falsification of purchase invoices from foreign component suppliers, or intentional concealment of taxable profits in the liasse fiscale.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 80% of the additional corporate income tax for deliberate incompleteness or false statements (article 1729 CGI), plus monthly late-payment interest; criminal fine up to €75,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; the judgment may be published on the DGFiP website.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The gérant or director who personally participates in the fraud may be made jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax and penalties, subjected to a travel ban, prohibited from managing a French company, and sentenced to 5 years' imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation Default / Incorrect TP
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to provide the complete Master File/Local File within the statutory response period (usually 30–60 days) and charging a non-arm's-length mark-up on intercompany sales of amorphous silicon detectors or raw materials to related entities in low-tax jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fine of 5% of the transfer-pricing reassessment (article 1735 B), plus 40% bad-faith penalty and late-payment interest; the tax administration may recharacterize the overpriced remuneration as a constructive dividend subject to 25% withholding tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly certify false transfer-pricing documentation face personal civil liability for the resulting tax shortfall; in cases of abus de droit, the corporate veil may be pierced and the director may incur personal fines and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using nominee shareholders or unreported beneficial owners in the SARL, or routing profit distributions through a shell entity in a blacklisted non-cooperative jurisdiction (ETNC) to evade treaty or anti-abuse rules.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Failure to file the beneficial ownership register (RBE) is punishable by 6 months' imprisonment and a fine of €7,500 per director; payments to ETNC entities face a 75% withholding tax; artificial arrangements are voided with an 80% anti-abuse penalty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Company directors and the de facto beneficial owner are jointly liable for restitution of unpaid taxes and penalties; asset freezes and travel bans may be imposed; serious AML violations carry up to 5 years' imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Treaty Abuse and Excessive Non-Resident Distributions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing significant dividends to a non-resident parent with insufficient substance, failing to satisfy the 2-year holding period or beneficial-ownership condition for the Parent-Subsidiary Directive, or using an artificial conduit to obtain treaty benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty exemption and re-application of the 25% dividend withholding tax, together with the 3% distribution surcharge; 80% penalty for misuse of law (abus de droit); monthly late-payment interest continues accruing; the case may be referred to the criminal authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative who fails to collect the required withholding tax becomes personally liable for the withheld amounts; directors may face civil damages, criminal convictions for fictitious dividend payments, and travel/asset restrictions.
